# Draft WA Residential Design Codes (draft-2026-10-24), machine-readable edition

> Every provision of the draft consolidated R-Codes (advertised 24 October 2026, consultation closes 26 February 2027) as a structured record with stable ID, printed text, source page and encoded test, with chapter digests and element packs sized for a model to assess a plan within a small token budget.

Start with README.md. Select the chapter by Table 1.1, read its digest, then open element packs.

## Entry

- [README](README.md): what this is, chapter selection, assessment procedure, statuses
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): instructions for Claude Code
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): assessment skill (rcodes-draft-assessment): procedure, both modes, report format
- [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md): what governs, versions, verification, citation, corrections, disclaimer
- [Worked example](worked/two-storey-r20-15x30.md): a two-storey, 5-bedroom project home design on a 15 m x 30 m R20 lot, plan-only and with a declared siting

## Chapter 1 operation

- [Operation](chapters/ch1/operation.md): Table 1.1, Figure 2.1, Table 2.4, LPP and LDP variation, clause 2.5.2
- [Permissions](chapters/ch1/permissions.md): per element, what an LPP and an LDP may vary and at what level

## Digests

- [Chapter 2 Single Houses](chapters/ch2/digest.md): one line per provision
- [Chapter 3 Grouped Dwellings](chapters/ch3/digest.md): one line per provision
- [Chapter 4 Part 1 Apartments R10 to R60](chapters/ch4p1/digest.md): one line per provision
- [Chapter 4 Part 2 Apartments R80 and above](chapters/ch4p2/digest.md): one line per provision

- [Topics](indexes/topics.md): subject keyword to rule IDs across chapters
- [Rules](indexes/rules.json): every rule, compact, with record path
- [Flagged records](indexes/flagged.md): records still flagged verify, with notes
